node.title: Re: Success with main page
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have had to change the hash-bang line to #!C:/strawberry/perl/bin/perl.exe from #!/usr/bin/perl. ... I don't want to have to change them all.

This is one of the things I meant when I wrote [id://11101895|this] about using a virtual machine instead of Windows.

The shebang issue has a workaround, as explained in [https://stackoverflow.com/a/2036584|this] StackOverflow answer: In the Apache config, use [http://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/mod/core.html#scriptinterpretersource|ScriptInterpreterSource Registry-Strict], and in the Windows Registry, set HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\.cgi\Shell\ExecCGI\Command to the path of perl.exe.
